# Separator

Use `Separator` for an unlabelled dividing rule with no built-in spacing. It is
decorative by default; set `decorative={false}` when the divider marks a real
section boundary. Use `orientation="vertical"` inside a container with a defined
height. Add surrounding space on the parent so the rule remains composable.
